function.description: This function validates an object to ensure it is safe to pass as a prop in a React component by checking that it is not a Promise and does not contain methods that could lead to side effects, raising a warning if the validation fails. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

obj.description: The object to validate for safe usage as a React prop. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

componentName.description: The name of the React component to which the object is passed as a prop. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.
